Name: JP's Utility Machines - Crop Compactor - Mobile Greenhouse
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i][u]Compact Crop Core[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Save space by placing several seeds inside the machine and, in due time, you will have all the production in your hands![/b][/size][/color]
[/font]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]In Robin's store you will find available for purchase 5 new machines that can help you a lot with space saving. These machines have capacities from 3 to 100 seeds, [/font][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia]they also act as greenhouses, so you can place any seed in any season and you will get all your production![/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]Crops that are harvested once (parsnips, beets, etc.) take the same amount of time to mature and produce their yield as they would if they were still in the soil. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]Crops that continue to produce after the first harvest will take a few more days to produce their yield, but will produce a full month's worth of produce. [/font][/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia]Days to Grow + (Days to Grow / Regrow Days)[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]Consideration is given to whether the plant can produce several products at once (e.g., cranberries). The amount of extra production is also chosen at random. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]No watering or care is required for crows, but they cannot be fertilized to speed up the process, and no crops obtained will be of silver quality or higher. [/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ffff00][size=5]The machines do not have that strange movement effect, but every so often an animation and sound will occur to let you know that they are in operation. [/size][/color][/i][/font][/b][/*]
[*][b][font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=5]Now it also works with seeds from other mods![/size][/color][/font][/b][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]The mechanics are very limited, so I did what I could with these aspects, trying to keep the game as balanced as possible. [/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia]
[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=5]In the Requirements section, I will leave another mod that will be useful for removing the seeds you place in the machines, otherwise you could lose them if you break the machine!!! [/size]

[/color][/i][/b]
[i][color=#ff0000][size=5]In theory that's it, the machines have special behavior with the Millennial Fruit and any mod crop that takes longer than 28 days and continues to produce over time. I hope you enjoy this Utility Machine.[/size][/color][/i]
[b][i][size=6][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]
Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/size][/i][/b][/font][i][b][size=4][font=Georgia]You are free to translate the mod;[color=#ff0000] you don't need to ask my permission[/color][color=#ff0000].[/color][/font]
[font=Georgia]You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.[/font]
[font=Georgia]If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/font][/size][/b][/i][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6]
